title: geckolib issue #755: Cannot invoke "net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity.isCurrentlyGlowing()" because "p_91315_" is null
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (MIT) does not cover issue text
text: [issue by medsal15] An enchanted Prismarine Helmet from [Minestuck](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/minestuck) will crash when the game tries to render it. [Crash report](https://mclo.gs/n9TY5us) Using NeoForge 21.1.187 for Minecraft 1.21.1, with GeckoLib 4.7.6, Minestuck 1.21.1-1.13.1.0 and Infiniverse 2.0.1.0 I think there's a null prevention check missing [at this line](https://github.com/bernie-g/geckolib/blob/1.21.1/common/src/main/java/software/bernie/geckolib/renderer/GeoArmorRenderer.java#L319) [comment by Witixin1512 (contributor)] As far as I believe, this is a Minestuck bug, they're calling `prepForRender` in `getHumanoidArmorModel` ([link](https://github.com/lunar-sway/minestuck/blob/main/src/main/java/com/mraof/minestuck/client/ClientProxy.java#L321-L322)), which according to the wiki isn't necessary in GeckoLib 4.5 (1.20.6+) [link](https://github.com/bernie-g/geckolib/wiki/Geckolib-Armor-(Geckolib4)). Its quite an easy one to miss 😅 . [comment by ellasgf839 (none)] I am also having this issue on all gecko lib mods, I isolated all of them and the issue still occurred [comment by Tslat (collaborator)] Provide a crash report then [comment by ellasgf839 (none)] [Crash Report ](https://mclo.gs/jYohaOk) The mod is Companions! There were a few mods that used GeckoLib that all shared the same error even when isolated I also used the newest versions of both GeckoLib and Companions! as well as the other mods on Forge and they seemed to work just fine, the problem is only with NeoForge [comment by Tslat (collaborator)] So this is an issue for companions to deal with then [comment by WilliamsGon (none)] Hey, I'm hitting the same bug. I saw the issue is closed, but I'm still getting the error on version 4.8.2 for NeoForge 1.21.1. Anyone know how to fix it so the item stops glitching out when it renders? [comment by Tslat (collaborator)] Sigh this is going to be a pain to try to resolve on GeckoLib's side, but it looks like enough people are failing to implement this properly that I probably need to idk I'll hold this forn ow [comment by muhammedesadcomert (none)] I'm also experiencing with the same issue: https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/CTqG396 [comment by CookieGD (none)] Some people on my server are experiencing the same or at least a really similar crash on Geckolib v4.8.2 and Neoforge 21.1.213 here's 2 crash reports that I got from my friends: https://gnomebot.dev/paste/254806806516203520/1449737621579497525/1449737621088632882 https://gnomebot.dev/paste/254806806516203520/1449737621579497525/1449737620480589873 [comment by CookieGD (none)] It keeps happening unfortunately, here's another crash from a different player. https://mclo.gs/Vsk7rc3 For some reason this crash almost always happens when my players explore the nether. [comment by wolfieboy09 (none)] Create: Northstar Redux has a band-aid solution here: https://github.com/Astronauts-of-Create/Northstar-Redux/blob/1.21.1/dev/src/main/java/com/lightning/northstar/item/SpaceSuitArmorItem.java#L49-L54 And with that, the game does not crash aside from nothing rendering: [comment by Tslat (collaborator)] Added a safety check in 4.8.3. There's nothing I can do to force this to work since it's fundamentally the mods using GeckoLib doing it incorrectly which causes the crash. Devs need to be using GeoRenderProvider for their GeckoLib models, not Forge/Neoforge hooks
